roleplayersquill.config.title: Roleplayer's Quill
roleplayersquill.config.reset.tooltip: Puts every setting back to what a fresh install would have. The symbols you have used are kept.
roleplayersquill.config.no_cloth: Install Cloth Config for the search and the side panel
roleplayersquill.option.replace_editor.t: Off leaves the vanilla editor exactly as it was. Even when on, opening a book while sneaking opens the vanilla editor, where other mods live – ImagineBook puts pictures on a page through it.
roleplayersquill.option.editor_scale.too: How much larger to draw the book while writing. The vanilla page is small.
roleplayersquill.option.show_counter.too: How many of the page's 1024 characters are spent, and how many of its fourteen lines.
roleplayersquill.option.show_guides.tool: Draws the page edge and the lines, so alignment can be seen rather than guessed at.
roleplayersquill.option.carry_formatting: Typing after a bold word keeps it bold, the way a word processor does.
roleplayersquill.option.default_alignmen: What a new paragraph and an imported one start as.
roleplayersquill.option.auto_correct.too: Put typography right while it is being written. What exactly, by the switches below.
roleplayersquill.option.auto_quotes.tool: A straight " becomes « or », depending on what is in front of it.
roleplayersquill.option.auto_dashes.tool: Two hyphens become a dash, three become a long one.
roleplayersquill.option.auto_ellipsis.to: Three dots become one character: narrower, and it never breaks across a line.
A straight ' becomes a curled one.
roleplayersquill.option.auto_capitals.to: The first letter of a sentence is made a capital. In the way if the book is full of invented names.
roleplayersquill.option.hyphenate.toolti: Break words across lines so the text sits close. Russian and English, by the rules of each.
roleplayersquill.option.hyphen_min_befor: How many letters must stay on the line before a hyphen.
roleplayersquill.option.hyphen_min_after: How many letters must be carried on to the next line.
roleplayersquill.option.page_break_hyphe: Break the word a page ends inside. Off moves it down whole.
roleplayersquill.option.justify_last_lin: Stretch the last line of a justified paragraph too. Typography says not to; some books do.
roleplayersquill.option.auto_paste_pages: A paste longer than the page flows into as many pages as it needs.
roleplayersquill.option.confirm_big_past: Say how many pages a paste will take before it takes them.
roleplayersquill.option.import_join_line: Only a blank line ends a paragraph, which is what a hard-wrapped text file wants.
roleplayersquill.option.export_folder.to: Where books are written, relative to the game folder.
roleplayersquill.option.rich_mode.toolti: A page can carry a link only when it is sent as a text component, which creative mode allows and nothing else does.
Colours and underlines linked words in the editor. It does not change the book.
roleplayersquill.option.reader_links.too: An address written in any book becomes clickable when you read it, with the same warning the chat gives.
roleplayersquill.option.reader_links_no_: Recognise example.com as well as https://example.com.
roleplayersquill.option.reader_tools.too: Finding, contents, the page list, keeping a copy and exporting, beside every signed book you open. Off leaves the vanilla book screen exactly as it was, addresses aside. Opening a book while sneaking leaves it off for that book no matter what this says.
roleplayersquill.option.reader_header: The header on a signed book
roleplayersquill.option.reader_header.to: The title, the author and which copy this is, in the book's own top border.
roleplayersquill.option.keep_opened_book: A copy of every signed book goes onto the shelf the moment it is opened, with its title, its author and its lore – so a book that is later lost, burnt or lent and not returned can still be read, and written back into a blank one. Filed under what is written in it: the same book read every day is one book on the shelf, not one a day.
roleplayersquill.option.sign_editor.tool: A row of symbols over the Done button. A sign's colour and glow come from dye and a glow ink sac rather than from its text, so there are no codes there.
roleplayersquill.option.anvil_editor.too: A vanilla server strips section signs out of renames, so this writes the character your server's plugin reads.
roleplayersquill.option.chat_symbols.too: A row of symbols over the chat box: the ones you have used, then a standard set, and a button for all the rest.
Off by default: a section sign gets you disconnected, and what the server reads instead is a guess about somebody else's plugin. Turn it on if you know what your server takes.
roleplayersquill.option.chat_prefix.tool: What starts a code in chat and in the anvil. Not a section sign: the server disconnects a client that sends one.
roleplayersquill.option.voice_enabled.to: Off until asked for. The model is downloaded the first time it is used and not before.
roleplayersquill.option.voice_model.tool: Which model to dictate with, and what it costs to download. Shared with Voice Subtitles if that is installed.
roleplayersquill.option.voice_auto_downl: Fetch the engine and the model the first time dictation is used.
roleplayersquill.option.voice_tidy.toolt: A capital at the front and a full stop at the back, where the model has not written them already.
roleplayersquill.rich.always: In creative, and say so otherwise
